en.title: SkyShowtime's New Swedish Crime Drama 'The Homicide Unit' Adds Two Nordic Stars
en.summary: Get ready for a dose of Nordic noir as SkyShowtime begins production on its latest original crime drama, 'The Homicide Unit.' The series taps into real-life elite detectives for its inspiration.
en.body:
SkyShowtime is doubling down on its commitment to original European content with the commencement of production on **National Homicide Unit** (working title), a gripping crime drama set to captivate audiences. Inspired by a real-life unit of elite Swedish homicide detectives, the series will follow a national team tasked with assisting local police forces on the country's most challenging murder cases. Filming is currently underway in the picturesque Helsingborg area of Sweden, setting the stage for a gritty and atmospheric procedural.

The series boasts a formidable cast, featuring internationally recognized Nordic talent. Swedish star **Pernilla August**, known for her roles in **"Blackwater"** and the iconic **"Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace,"** is set to lead the charge. She is joined by Icelandic actress **Anita Briem**, adding another layer of established talent to the ensemble. The focus on top female investigators promises a fresh perspective within the crowded crime drama landscape, highlighting sharp minds and unwavering determination.

## Elite Detectives Take Center Stage

**National Homicide Unit** is an eight-episode original series that delves into the intricate world of solving complex homicides. The premise of an elite national unit stepping in for the toughest cases suggests a high level of stakes and suspense. Viewers can expect intricate plots and a deep dive into the psychological aspects of both the investigators and the crimes they are trying to solve. The involvement of Warner Bros. International Television Production (WBITVP) Sweden as a producer further solidifies the show's potential for high production values and international appeal.

## What Fans Can Expect

For fans of procedural dramas and Nordic crime fiction, **National Homicide Unit** arrives as a highly anticipated addition to the streaming landscape. The inspiration drawn from real detectives hints at a grounded and authentic portrayal of police work, moving beyond sensationalism towards a more nuanced exploration of justice. The combination of a compelling premise, a stunning Swedish setting, and the presence of respected actresses like **Pernilla August** creates a strong foundation for a binge-worthy series. The series is poised to offer a sophisticated narrative arc, exploring the pressures and triumphs of those dedicated to unraveling the darkest mysteries.

## What's Next

While specific release dates for **National Homicide Unit** on SkyShowtime have not yet been announced, the commencement of production signals that the series is on track for a future debut. Fans should keep an eye on SkyShowtime announcements for further details regarding the premiere and potential international distribution.
